title: Application to Study Permit Process Steps for Norway
notice: 1 NOK ≈ 13 BDT (Academic Year 2026/2027). Block money is NOT a fee — it is your own living money deposited to the university account and refunded upon arrival.

processSteps.label: University Application : via søknadsweb.no or individual university portal
Offer / Admission Letter
bullets: Many Norwegian public universities are tuition-free for all students

processSteps.label: Student Housing Deposit (SiO / Sammen) : 5,000–10,000 NOK (65,000–1,30,000 BDT)
bullets: Fully refundable when you move out
Apply for housing early — spots fill quickly

processSteps.label: Block Money Deposit to University Account : 170,368 NOK (~22,15,000 BDT) for 2026–27
bullets: Required by UDI as proof of living funds for one academic year
Amount increases slightly each year — check UDI website for current figure
Refunded to your bank account after you arrive in Norway

processSteps.label: UDI Study Permit Application (online) : 5,400 NOK (70,200 BDT)
VFS Global Dhaka Biometrics Appointment : ~€22 (3,000–4,000 BDT)

costSteps.label: UDI Study Permit Fee : 5,400 NOK (70,200 BDT) — paid online
VFS Global Dhaka Service Fee : ~€22 (~3,000–4,000 BDT) — biometrics
Block Money : 170,368 NOK (22,15,000 BDT) — refunded after arrival
Student Housing Deposit : 5,000–10,000 NOK — refundable on moving out
